novel_policies.label: advanced practice nurse collaboration authorized
novel_policies.quote: A podiatric physician in active clinical practice may collaborate with an advanced practice registered nurse in accordance with the requirements of the Nurse Practice Act.

novel_policies.label: ankle surgery standard of care reference
novel_policies.quote: A licensed podiatrist who performs ankle surgery must meet the same standard of care applicable to orthopedic surgeons who perform ankle surgery.

novel_policies.label: assistant surgeon role authorized
novel_policies.quote: podiatrists may function as assistant surgeons in nonpodiatric procedures

novel_policies.label: cosmetic procedures included
novel_policies.quote: the term 'cosmetic' means a surgical or medical procedure intended to enhance the physical appearance or function of the foot, ankle, or leg, including, but not limited to, skin problems such as blemishes, spider veins, and scar revisions

novel_policies.label: does not offer reciprocity
novel_policies.quote: There shall be no reciprocity in granting licenses for the practice of podiatric medicine and surgery (podiatry) to licensees from other states or countries.

novel_policies.label: minor patient chaperone requirement
novel_policies.quote: A parent, guardian or other caretaker, or an adult staff member, shall be present when a person licensed under this chapter provides outpatient treatment to a minor patient who is disrobed or partially disrobed

novel_policies.label: noncompete clause restriction
novel_policies.quote: Any contract or agreement which creates or established the terms of a partnership, employment, or any other form of professional relationship with a podiatrist licensed by the board to practice in this state, which includes any restriction to the right of such podiatrist to also practice podiatry in any geographic area for any period of time after the termination of such partnership, employment, or professional relationship shall be void and unenforceable

novel_policies.label: authorizes amputation up to the forefoot excluded
novel_policies.quote: except (1) the amputation of the forefoot

novel_policies.label: anatomical scope upper boundary: foot ankle and soft tissue to distal tibial metaphyseal flare
novel_policies.quote: the ailments of the human foot, ankle and soft tissue structures extending no higher than the distal tibial metaphyseal flair

novel_policies.label: ankle surgery facility requirement: multispecialty ambulatory surgical facility
novel_policies.quote: any surgery on the ankle or on the soft tissue structures related to the ankle, any amputations, and any surgical correction of clubfoot shall be performed by a podiatrist only in a hospital licensed under Article 5 of Chapter 131E of the General Statutes or in a multispecialty ambulatory surgical facility that is not a licensed office setting

novel_policies.label: ankle surgery residency requirement: board certification or qualification required
novel_policies.quote: The board shall certify a podiatrist whom it considers qualified by education, training, and experience or who is certified by the American board of podiatric surgery.

novel_policies.label: vaccination authority
novel_policies.quote: vaccination of patients 18 years of age and older in accordance with Section 20.6 upon completion of appropriate training

novel_policies.label: wound debridement authorized
novel_policies.quote: wound debridement on the limbs and torso, by all appropriate and lawful means

novel_policies.label: ankle surgery board certification timeline
novel_policies.quote: must obtain certification to perform reconstructive rearfoot/ankle surgery from the American Board of Podiatric Surgery within six (6) years of May 24, 2000, or within six (6) years of first becoming eligible for certification

novel_policies.label: clubfoot surgery restriction
novel_policies.quote: Excluded from the definition of podiatry is the amputation of the entire foot, the administration of an anesthetic other than local, and the surgical correction of clubfoot of an infant two years of age or less.

novel_policies.label: electronic prescribing required
novel_policies.quote: no person licensed under this chapter shall issue any prescription unless such prescription is made by electronic prescription from the person issuing the prescription to a pharmacy

novel_policies.label: hospital privileges nondiscrimination
novel_policies.quote: medical staff governing documents shall include and provide for the right to pursue and practice full clinical and surgical surgical privileges for holders of a Doctor of Podiatric Medicine (DPM) degree within the scope of his licensure

novel_policies.label: has credential pegged
novel_policies.quote: is a graduate of a school of podiatry approved by the board

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a division
novel_policies.quote: There shall be a board of podiatry consisting of 5 members; including 4 licensed podiatrists and one public member

novel_policies.label: nondiscrimination in public programs
novel_policies.quote: No department, office, or agency of the state or county government... shall deny to the recipient or beneficiary of podiatric aid or services the freedom to choose podiatric care or services which are within the scope of activities of a podiatrist

novel_policies.label: preoperative history and physical authorized
novel_policies.quote: 'Practice of podiatric medicine' includes the performance of a history and physical on a podiatrist's preoperative patient and upon the patient's admission into a hospital or ambulatory surgical center.

novel_policies.label: anatomical scope upper boundary: foot ankle and soft tissue below mid calf
novel_policies.quote: human toe, foot, ankle, tendons that insert into the foot, and soft tissue below the mid-calf

novel_policies.label: ankle surgery residency requirement: hospital credentialing required
novel_policies.quote: surgical treatment of the ankle authorized only when a podiatrist has been granted privileges to perform ankle surgery by a hospital's medical staff credentialing committee based on the training and experience of the podiatrist

novel_policies.label: ankle surgery residency requirement: 24 month surgical residency
novel_policies.quote: shall either be board certified in foot and ankle surgery by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery or shall complete a twenty-four-month postgraduate clinical residency in podiatric surgery

novel_policies.label: lacks systemic disease local manifestations included
novel_policies.quote: excepting treatment of systemic conditions

novel_policies.label: telehealth authorized
novel_policies.quote: A person licensed under this chapter may provide telehealth services as long as the licensee acts within the scope of practice of the licensee's license

novel_policies.label: tibial pilon fracture excluded
novel_policies.quote: such podiatrist shall restrict treatment of displaced ankle fractures to the initial diagnosis and the initial attempt at closed reduction at the time of presentation and shall not treat tibial pilon fractures

novel_policies.label: total ankle replacement authorized
novel_policies.quote: a licensed podiatrist who has provided documentation to the Department of Public Health of meeting the requirements set forth in subdivision (1) or (2) of subsection (c) of section 20-54 may apply to a hospital in the state for privileges to perform total ankle replacement surgery

novel_policies.label: controlled substances prescribing ce required
novel_policies.quote: a minimum of 2 hours of continuing education related to the safe and effective prescribing of controlled substances

novel_policies.label: does not require continuing education
novel_policies.quote: evidence of the podiatrist's maintenance of professional medical competence, which may include continuing podiatric medical education, postgraduate studies, institutes, seminars, lectures, conferences, work shops, professional evaluation, and specialty board certification or recertification during the preceding four (4) years

novel_policies.label: school approval basis: unspecified
novel_policies.quote: completing the requirements for the degree as a doctor of podiatric medicine

novel_policies.label: experience source: none
novel_policies.quote: submit a certificate of graduation from a legally chartered school of podiatry approved by the board

novel_policies.label: physician assistant collaboration authorized
novel_policies.quote: A licensed podiatrist may collaborate with a physician assistant or an orthopedic physician assistant licensed pursuant to chapter 19 of this title.

novel_policies.label: authorizes amputation up to the chopart joint and below
novel_policies.quote: The practice of podiatry shall include the amputation of the toes and other parts of the foot and ankle, but shall not include any amputation above the Chopart joint

novel_policies.label: authorizes amputation up to the transmetatarsal and below
novel_policies.quote: Podiatric surgery shall not include amputation of the leg or foot other than from the transmetatarsal level to the toes.

novel_policies.label: authorizes amputation up to the toes only
novel_policies.quote: The term does not include the amputation of the entire foot, but does include the amputation of an entire toe if the amputation is performed at an institution: (1) that is approved by a joint commission of accredited hospital organizations; and (2) where comanagement of the patient is being performed by a physician licensed under IC 25-22.5.

novel_policies.label: anesthesia authority: local and conscious sedation
novel_policies.quote: Administer local anesthesia. Administer conscious sedation in a hospital or an ambulatory surgical center.

novel_policies.label: does not authorize ankle surgery
novel_policies.quote: "foot" means that part of the human anatomy which consists of the tarsal bones, metatarsal bones and phalanges.

novel_policies.label: ankle surgery facility requirement: licensed hospital only
novel_policies.quote: Surgical treatment of the ankle by a podiatrist shall be performed only in a medical care facility, as defined in K.S.A. 65-425, and amendments thereto.

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a department
novel_policies.quote: The Department of Public Health shall hold examinations under the supervision of the board at least once each year

novel_policies.label: opioid prescribing rules required
novel_policies.quote: By January 1, 2019, the board must adopt rules establishing requirements for prescribing opioid drugs.

novel_policies.label: podiatric assistant supervision level
novel_policies.quote: a medical assistant working under the indirect supervision of a licensed podiatric physician

novel_policies.label: anatomical scope upper boundary: foot ankle and leg below knee
novel_policies.quote: "Leg" means that part of the lower limb between the knee and the foot.

novel_policies.label: anesthesia authority: general permitted with physician supervision
novel_policies.quote: general anaesthetics may be used only in colleges of podiatry approved by the board and in hospitals approved by the joint commission on the accreditation of hospitals, or the American Osteopathic Association

novel_policies.label: anesthesia authority: local and moderate deep sedation
novel_policies.quote: Podiatric surgery requiring an anesthetic other than a local anesthetic shall be performed in a facility accredited by the Joint Commission on Accreditation of Healthcare Organizations or a freestanding surgery center accredited by the Accreditation Association for Ambulatory Health Care

novel_policies.label: professional liability insurance required
novel_policies.quote: Each person licensed to practice podiatric medicine under the provisions of section 20-54 or 20-57 who provides direct patient care services shall maintain professional liability insurance or other indemnity against liability for professional malpractice.

novel_policies.label: xray technician certification required
novel_policies.quote: no person shall perform X-ray procedures in a podiatrist office who does not meet these standards and who has not received a certificate of proficiency from the board

novel_policies.label: impaired practitioner program
novel_policies.quote: The board may establish protocols for the operation of a professional review committee... The board has the power to contract with other agencies, individuals, firms or associations for the conduct and operation of a podiatrist health program

novel_policies.label: anatomical scope upper boundary: foot ankle and soft tissue to myotendinous junction triceps surae
novel_policies.quote: "ankle" means the distal metaphysis and epiphysis of the tibia and fibula, the articular cartilage of the distal tibia and distal fibula, the ligaments that connect the distal metaphysis and epiphysis of the tibia and fibula and the talus, and the portions of skin, subcutaneous tissue, fascia, muscles, tendons and nerves at or below the level of the myotendinous junction of the triceps surae

novel_policies.label: anatomical scope upper boundary: foot only
novel_policies.quote: "Podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis or medical, surgical (as described in IC 25-22.5-1-1.1 (a)(1)(C)), and mechanical treatment of the human foot and related structures.

novel_policies.label: systemic disease local manifestations included
novel_policies.quote: 'Podiatric medicine' includes treatment of local manifestations of systemic diseases as they appear on the foot and ankle

novel_policies.label: authorizes amputation up to the foot entirety excluded
novel_policies.quote: diagnosing or medically, surgically, mechanically, manipulatively or electrically treating ailments of the human foot and leg but not amputating the leg or entire foot

novel_policies.label: anatomical scope upper boundary: foot ankle and soft tissue to tibial tuberosity
novel_policies.quote: Surgical treatment, as herein used, shall mean the surgical treatment of the foot and ankle and those soft tissue structures below the knee governing the function of the foot and ankle, but shall not include the amputation of the leg, surgery of the knee joint, surgery of the bony structures proximal to the distal half of the tibia

novel_policies.label: has advisory board
novel_policies.quote: The Department of Public Health shall hold examinations under the supervision of the board at least once each year

novel_policies.label: experience source: embedded in credential
novel_policies.quote: graduated from a college of podiatric medicine accredited by the Council on Podiatry Education of the American Podiatry Association or approved by state licensing boards

novel_policies.label: podiatric assistant authorized
novel_policies.quote: A podiatric medical assistant may assist a podiatrist pursuant to rules adopted by the board.

novel_policies.label: board certification body
novel_policies.quote: board certified or board qualified by the American Board of Foot and Ankle Surgery

novel_policies.label: office based surgery accreditation required
novel_policies.quote: No person licensed under this chapter shall perform any office-based surgery, as defined in § 122(3)y. of Title 16, in a facility unless it is accredited or licensed in accordance with § 122(3)z. of Title 16.

novel_policies.label: anesthesia authority: general excluded
novel_policies.quote: shall not include the amputation of the leg, surgery of the knee joint, surgery of the bony structures proximal to the distal half of the tibia, or the administration or monitoring of general anesthesia.

novel_policies.label: ankle surgery residency requirement
novel_policies.quote: graduated on or after June 1, 2006, from a three-year residency program in podiatric medicine and surgery that was accredited, at the time of graduation, by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education; and is board certified in reconstructive rearfoot and ankle surgery by the American Board of Foot and Ankle Surgery

novel_policies.label: does not require post degree experience
novel_policies.quote: Each applicant who desires to practice podiatry shall meet the qualifications prescribed in AS 08.64.200(a)(3) - (5) and shall (1) submit a certificate of graduation from a legally chartered school of podiatry approved by the board; (2) take the examination required by AS 08.64.210

novel_policies.label: systemic disease treatment excluded
novel_policies.quote: The use of such drugs and medicines in the treatment of ailments of the human foot shall not include the treatment of any systemic diseases.

novel_policies.label: ankle surgery facility requirement
novel_policies.quote: Surgical treatment of the ankle by a podiatrist shall be performed only in a licensed acute care hospital or a licensed ambulatory surgical clinic.
